Beside her on the right, the Asian man in the red polo (R3) stands with hands on his hips, looking to the left. In the background, the heavy-set man in black (R1) is on the left, the woman in the dark t-shirt (R4) is in the center, and the bald man in the dark t-shirt (R2) is on the right. Bright daylight illuminates the group.
